62305.name: Navigator Drive · First Strike
62305.SpecificEffects:
Enables the ST's adjacent <color=#F74848>2</color>-tile area to become a valid attack zone for allied Missile Launcher and Rocket Launcher attacks. Attacks directed by this effect gain Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+25%</color>.
When actively attacking for the <color=#F74848>1st</color> time each turn, DMG <color=#F74848>+7.5%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
ST Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color> and DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
